name: packaging-design-assistant
description: Plan packaging concepts, label layouts, visual directions, structural ideas, materials, dieline content, mockups, print checks, and packaging copy for consumer products.

interface.longDescription: Develop original packaging concepts for consumer products. Plan labels and panels, compare formats and materials, map supplied dielines, draft copy from verified facts, prepare cautious print checklists, create concept mockups, and review shelf and ecommerce clarity. The skills separate creative suggestions from current legal, manufacturer, and printer requirements.
defaultPrompt: Create three distinct packaging concepts for my product.
Plan the front and back panels using only the facts I provide.
Review this package design and prepare a printer handoff checklist.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides packaging design guidance and text only. It does not offer purchases, subscriptions, referrals, transactions, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: Added the dedicated product page URL and corrected the public submission ZIP structure. No skill behavior changes.
